title: A task from start to finish
desc: You say what you want. The AI writes a plan, which other AIs check. The plan is cut into small tickets. For each ticket, tests are written and locked, the AI builds until they pass, and the server checks again and merges. You read the report. When the AI is stuck, the advisor decides.

nodes.text:
2. The AI writes a plan
Other AIs with fresh eyes check it
3. The plan is cut into small tickets

5. The AI builds until
the locked tests pass
6. The server checks again and merges

The advisor decides
A person, or a second AI
